payload.author: claude
payload.body: PARITY NOTE (board audit): the calls epic is CONTROL-PLANE complete (lifecycle, authz, CallCommand routing, WebRTCSignal gating, ringing push, P2P + E2EE, LiveKit token SFU), but the self-hosted SFU MEDIA PLANE is NOT at TS parity: SFU media negotiation (mediasoup produce/consume) is stubbed and multi-box/region media placement is not ported. Filed as FR-292 (SFU media negotiation) + FR-293 (SFU media placement). These are only needed for self-hosted-mediasoup group calls; the LiveKit path ships without them. See the mediasoup-vs-LiveKit decision.
